name: Auth0 Next.js SDK
solves: Implements user authentication in Next.js applications using Auth0 as the identity provider, handling login, logout, session management, token refresh, and middleware-based route protection with encrypted cookie-based sessions.
best_for: Next.js apps (App Router and Pages Router) that need production-grade authentication backed by Auth0's managed identity platform
Applications requiring social login, enterprise SSO, or MFA without building identity infrastructure from scratch
Teams already using Auth0 as their identity provider who want a first-party Next.js integration
Preview/dynamic deployment environments (Vercel, Netlify) that need automatic base URL inference for auth callbacks
Next.js 15 and 16 projects that need middleware or proxy-based session rolling and route protection
skip_when: You are not using Next.js — this SDK is exclusively designed for the Next.js framework
You want a self-hosted or vendor-neutral auth solution without dependency on Auth0's managed service
Your project is a pure SPA or static site with no server-side rendering or API routes
You need authentication for a non-React framework like Express, Fastify, or Django
Budget constraints prevent using Auth0's paid tiers and you need a fully free/open-source identity provider
